criteria.evidence: The new migration grants service_role USAGE on schema private and EXECUTE only on private.publish_content_revision(uuid,uuid), private.unpublish_content_revision(uuid,uuid), and private.is_active_admin(uuid).

Focused pgTAP verifies PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated lack EXECUTE on all three private functions and confirms all three existing public PR-004B wrappers remain security invoker. The migration contains no table grant, RLS, admin-rule, or Data API change.

Under SET LOCAL ROLE service_role, pgTAP passed first publish, draft photograph replacement by a second active admin, later draft edit and republish, and unpublish through the unchanged public wrappers. It also proved both immutable revisions and their old/new cover snapshots remain correct.
Clean local reset applied the new migration; all 3 pgTAP files passed 116 assertions; TypeScript, ESLint, 350 standard tests, production build, and git diff --check passed.
The result validates against the approved contract, records every private grant, and is used to close both project and global ledgers without release action.
